# SortZone hooks for pinning non-sortable siblings and scoping dragElement

## Context

When a `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` subclass excludes non-sortable sibling items through `isDraggableItem(item)` / `getSortableItems(owner.items)` inside a flex container (e.g., pinned or locked items interspersed with sortable items), `SortZone#onDragStart` only switches `sortableItems` to `position: 'absolute'` while leaving excluded sibling items in normal flex flow. As soon as the sortable siblings leave normal flow, any non-sortable sibling collapses toward the start of the container instead of holding its visual slot. In addition, `onDragStart` hardcodes `dragElement: VDomUtil.find(owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom` with no hook for subclasses whose `dragHandleSelector` should also scope the drag proxy root node.

## The Problem

Because `SortZone#onDragStart` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:881–1046`) and `SortZone#processDragEnd` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:578–716`) inline the pinned-item set (`sortableItems`) and the initial `dragElement` lookup without subclass hooks, any `SortZone` subclass that needs non-sortable sibling items to remain pinned at their measured DOM rects during an active drag (or needs the drag proxy to clone a descendant handle node rather than the whole item) is forced to re-implement `onDragStart` and `processDragEnd`.

## The Architectural Reality

- `SortZone#getSortableItems(items=this.owner.items)` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:350–354`) filters `owner.items` via `getDraggableItems(items)` (`isDraggableItem`).
- `SortZone#onDragStart` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:962–1036`) measures `owner.getDomRect([owner.id].concat(sortableItems.map(e => e.id)))` and sets `position: 'absolute'` on `sortableItems` only, while `SortZone#processDragEnd` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:631–652`) restores `wrapperStyle` on `me.sortableItems` only.
- `SortZone#onDragStart` (`src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs:937`) sets `dragElement: VDomUtil.find(owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom` directly instead of delegating to a protected `getDragElement(draggedItem, handleNode)` hook with `handleNode` resolved to the matched handle VDOM node in `owner.vdom`.

## The Fix

1. Add a protected hook `getPinnedItems(ownerItems=this.owner.items, sortableItems=this.sortableItems)` on `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` (defaulting to `sortableItems` so existing behavior is unchanged; subclasses with non-sortable siblings in the same flex flow can return `ownerItems` so all siblings are measured, pinned at their rects during the drag, and restored in `processDragEnd`). The returned set must contain every entry in `sortableItems` in `owner.items` order.
2. Add a protected hook `getDragElement(draggedItem, handleNode=null)` on `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone` (defaulting to `VDomUtil.find(this.owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom`, where `handleNode` is the matched drag handle VDOM node resolved from `owner.vdom` when `dragHandleSelector` is active).
3. Update `onDragStart` and `processDragEnd` in `src/draggable/container/SortZone.mjs` to measure, pin, and restore the `getPinnedItems(...)` set while keeping `sortableItems` / `itemRects` as the active sort participants.

## Contract Ledger

| Target surface | Authority | Proposed behavior | Fallback | Docs | Evidence |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone#getPinnedItems` | this ticket | returns the item set measured, pinned (`position: 'absolute'`), and restored across `onDragStart` / `processDragEnd`; must contain every entry in `sortableItems` in `owner.items` order | defaults to `sortableItems` | JSDoc | unit |
| `Neo.draggable.container.SortZone#getDragElement` | this ticket | returns the VDOM root cloned into the drag proxy for `draggedItem`, receiving `(draggedItem, handleNode)` where `handleNode` is the matched drag handle VDOM node resolved from `owner.vdom` when `dragHandleSelector` is active | defaults to `VDomUtil.find(this.owner.vdom, draggedItem.id).vdom` | JSDoc | unit |

Decision Record impact: none.

## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `SortZone#getPinnedItems` defaults to `sortableItems` (preserving all existing `SortZone` unit/component specs) and when overridden to return `owner.items`, pins and restores excluded non-sortable siblings alongside `sortableItems` in `onDragStart` / `processDragEnd` (unit).
- [ ] `SortZone#getDragElement(draggedItem, handleNode)` defaults to the item root VDOM and allows a subclass to return the handle VDOM node for the drag proxy (unit).

## Out of Scope

- Changing `SortZone#getSortableItems` or `switchItems` semantics for default callers where `getPinnedItems` is not overridden.

## Avoided Traps

- Including non-sortable items inside `sortableItems` (which would allow `switchItems` to swap them); pinning and sorting are distinct responsibilities when a container holds fixed/locked items beside sortable ones.
